cohort: The study included 8888 deliveries from women who gave birth at a tertiary Hospital in Bandar Abbas, Iran, between January 2020 and January 2022.
finding: The Random Forest Classification model demonstrated high accuracy (0.99) in predicting birth asphyxia, with maternal chronic hypertension, maternal anemia, diabetes, and gestational age among the most weighted predictive factors.
mod_finding: Delivery method was identified as a weighted factor in the machine learning model for predicting birth asphyxia.
